newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus prices new A319 corporate jet.
newsitem.headline: Airbus prices new A319 corporate jet.

text.p: European aircraft consortium Airbus Industrie said on Tuesday the new Corporate Jet version of its A319 airliner would cost customers in the region of $40 million.

Sales chief John Leahy told reporters at the Paris air show, where the new version was launched on Sunday, that the basic aircraft would cost $35 million, with fitting-out likely to cost a further $5 million.
The price is in line with that of rival Boeing Co's Business Jet based on a hybrid version of its new 737-700 and 737-800 airliners.

Boeing Business Jet president Borge Boeskov said at the air show last Saturday that his aircraft was fetching $30.5 million before fitting-out costs of $4-8 million, but the basic price was going up to $32 million from next month with a further increase envisaged next year.
